cohort: The study cohort consisted of 339 newly arrived immigrant women who received multicultural doula support and 339 similar newly arrived immigrant women who did not, giving birth in Norway between 2018 and 2023.
finding: Multicultural doula support was associated with a lower likelihood of emergency caesarean sections, reduced risk of estimated blood loss >=1000 ml for vaginal births, increased use of pain relief in labour, and higher rates of exclusive breastfeeding at discharge.
mod_finding: Women receiving MCD support had a 41% lower likelihood of emergency caesarean sections and those giving birth vaginally had a 75% lower risk of estimated blood loss >=1000 ml.
